s2s/audio_server.py.source: Repository live display-ASR during tool injection with retained once-only LLM audio replay; exact input onset/audio clock transport preserves native ownership; stateless final NeMo wrapper token measurement uses the loaded tokenizer. CPU regression covers blocked injection, no sequence writes on measurement and ahead-ASR ownership; GPU acceptance remains separate.

s2s/prompt_template.jinja.source: User-supplied deployed voicechat-prompt-template.jinja; strict session policy and single-call examples updated in this repository; search_knowledge_base(query) example covers consumer and business product facts and forbids lack-of-access responses when a registered tool covers the request Replace fixed multi-attribute catalog example with a format-only faithful user/query pair; require exact real attributes and native first-question product lookup. CueKB evidence/2.1 results are terminal question-level decisions: consume decision/evidence/missing once and never split, generalize, or retry the same input.

opt/tritonserver/backends/nemotron-voice.source: User-supplied load_utils.py uploaded 2026-10-19, preserved byte-for-byte with LF newlines. Converting only LF to CRLF reproduces the supplied deployed checksum; no code changes.

s2s/tests/test_response_lifecycle.py.source: Repository CPU regression: real decode/resample/submission fingerprints, unmodified samples, ASR parts and IDs, diagnostics disabled, and no transcript content in logs; retain batch aggregate result tests. Deterministic-clock regression sends more than two seconds of catch-up ACK plus adjacent response PCM through the real ordered writer; verifies packet identity/order, bounded playback lead, idle no-credit and cancellation. CPU server dispatch regression for ACK/result/follow-up/answer boundaries, stable call ownership and a general next question. Verify completed assistant response context is cleared and never attached to the next user ASR event.
